answer: Because the haven release is logged with every signature, the trellis audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 6 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the plume graph and each risks its bond. That is 35 dollars per alias.
